mapper.select: SELECT CAST(payment_time AS date) AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS paidOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(payment_price), 0) AS amount FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND is_pay = '1' AND payment_time IS NOT NULL AND payment_time >= #{window.startAt} AND payment_time < #{window.endAt} GROUP BY CAST(payment_time AS date) ORDER BY date
SELECT MIN(payment_time) FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND is_pay = '1' AND payment_time IS NOT NULL AND payment_time < #{cutoff}

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE create_time >= #{today.startAt} AND create_time < #{today.endAt}) AS todayNewUserCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE create_time >= #{month.startAt} AND create_time < #{month.endAt}) AS monthNewUserCount, COUNT(*) AS totalUserCount FROM user_info WHERE del_flag = '0'
